extra.message: The packet_ref query parameter is joined to BASE_EXPORT_DIR and read without validating path containment. A caller possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can supply ../ components or an absolute path to read files outside private_exports with the application's filesystem permissions.

extra.message: The name query parameter determines the destination passed to mkdir() and write_bytes(request.body), without path containment checks. A caller possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can use traversal or an absolute path to create or overwrite arbitrary files writable by the application.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: The url query parameter flows directly into urllib.request.urlopen(), and the response preview is returned to the caller. cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: Request-body bytes or the blob query parameter, optionally base64-decoded, are passed directly to pickle.loads(). A caller possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can supply a malicious pickle that executes arbitrary code during deserialization.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The expr query parameter is evaluated as Python code. Setting __builtins__ to an empty dictionary does not prevent access to Python's object hierarchy and loaded classes. cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: The fragment query parameter is concatenated into Jinja2 template source and rendered using an unrestricted Template. When Jinja2 is installed, a caller possessing INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can execute template expressions that access Python objects and invoke arbitrary server-side code.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: The XML parser explicitly enables DTD loading and entity resolution and disables the network prohibition before parsing request.body. Returning only doc.tag does not prevent resolution during parsing.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: Successful requests authenticated with INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN log the complete Authorization header and decoded request body at WARNING level. Bearer credentials and any sensitive payroll payload are copied into application logs without redaction.

extra.message: When DEBUG is enabled, which settings.py enables by default, the entire upload directory is served through unauthenticated /media/ routes. Randomized filenames do not enforce authorization.

cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: API-key authentication checks key.active but never owner.is_active. Disabling a user through user_edit() therefore leaves their existing API keys usable. cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: OnboardingTaskForm exposes every status choice to managers. task_create() and task_edit() save this form directly instead of calling transition_task(). cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: An assigned employee can upload replacement evidence for a task in any state. cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: Invite availability is checked before account creation, and the invite is consumed afterward without a transaction, row lock, or conditional update. cwe: CWE-367: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition

extra.message: employee_detail() passes every employee onboarding task to the template without using visible_tasks_queryset(). cwe: CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: The onboarding CSV export writes manager-controlled task titles and user-controlled names directly into cells. extra.message: Django's SECRET_KEY falls back to a publicly known hardcoded value whenever DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is absent. This fallback remains active with DEBUG disabled, leaving Django-signed data protected by a key known to anyone who can read the source.

extra.message: DEBUG defaults to True when DJANGO_DEBUG is not provided. Requests that trigger unhandled exceptions receive Django technical error pages exposing source locations, stack traces, and local variables; unmatched routes also disclose URL configuration.

cwe: CWE-489: Active Debug Code

extra.message: Cookie settings enable HttpOnly and SameSite but never set SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, leaving Django's False default active even with DEBUG disabled. cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute

extra.message: Audit logging unconditionally trusts the first client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value instead of verifying that the request came from a trusted proxy.
